bead.title: service: back ListModels with the unified model snapshot
bead.description:
CONTEXT
Root `FizeauService.ListModels` still performs its own inline discovery in `service_models.go`, while `fiz models` reads `internal/modelregistry.ModelSnapshot`. SD-005 requires a single enriched available-model view. Keeping two discovery/enrichment paths creates operator/routing drift.

CHANGE
Rewrite root `ListModels` to render from the same model snapshot helper used by `fiz models`, preserving public `ModelInfo` behavior. Delete or reduce legacy inline discovery helpers in `service_models.go` after the snapshot-backed path is in place.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- service_models.go
- service_models_test.go
- service_models_integration_test.go only if test expectations need refresh
- shared snapshot adapter tests from the previous bead

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Route resolution and scoring.
- RouteStatus.
- Removing the deprecated CLI `--list-models` compatibility flag unless an existing test explicitly covers that compatibility.
bead.acceptance:
1. `go test . -run "TestListModels" -count=1` passes with root ListModels assertions updated to prove rows come from the enriched snapshot, including endpoint/server-instance/runtime quota metadata.
2. `go test ./agentcli -run "TestCLI_ListModels|TestModelsList" -count=1` passes, proving CLI and root service render compatible model metadata.
3. `rg -n "func discoverAndRankModels|func discoverModelsInline|listModelsForProvider" service_models.go` returns no matches, or any remaining match is a thin compatibility wrapper with a test name documenting why it remains.
